ayahs.1: Has news of the Overwhelming Event reached you?
ayahs.2: Some faces that Day will be downcast,
ayahs.5: given only scalding water to drink,
ayahs.6: with no food except a foul, thorny plant
ayahs.7: that neither nourishes nor satisfies hunger.
ayahs.8: Other faces that Day will glow with bliss,
ayahs.11: where no idle talk is heard,
ayahs.17: Do they not reflect on camels—how they were masterfully created;
ayahs.18: on the sky—how it was raised;
ayahs.19: on the mountains—how they were anchored;
ayahs.20: and on the earth—how it was spread out?
ayahs.21: So remind—all you can do is remind.
ayahs.22: You are not there to compel them.
ayahs.23: Whoever turns away, persisting in rejection,
ayahs.24: Allah will inflict the greatest punishment.
ayahs.26: and with Us is their reckoning.
